readings_ruling: The reading of « connexe » in the Remark's last sentence (l.503–504) is not open, and the Remark's mark stands. The text settles it three ways. (1) Déf. 12 itself (benzecri1960_ch1.tex l.304–309) defines a « variété localement projective (resp. affine) » on « une variété V, convexe [sic: lire connexe], de dimension n ». So « Soit V une variété localement affine » (l.493) already contains connectedness by definition. The transcription flags the [sic], and docs/CAMPAIGN.md fixes the reading (« Def. 12 prints « convexe », read « connexe » »). (2) docs/CAMPAIGN.md, « Implicit hypotheses », is the protocol's standing convention: a « variété » is connected, Hausdorff and second countable unless the author says otherwise. (3) The Remark spells out its own conclusion: « on a l'énoncé : », followed by Prop. 7′ (l.507–508), which prints « connexe ». There is also a precedent. DEC-120 accepted Prop. 1's mark with « ouvert U » read connected, « consistent with « variété » connected », and kept the disconnected counterexample as a remark, not a finding. not_deuxPointsDansPocheAffineSansConnexe belongs in that category: it shows that the reading the text excludes is false. It is not a finding against the paper. kb 0006's « reading the paper does not settle » therefore does not apply. The closer cited only (2) and (3); (1) is the strongest and should be cited (finding 1). DEC-122 is about Hausdorffness (the cone base B, and U in Déf. 16). It has nothing to say about connectedness and is not needed here. Scan check: journal p. 253 (PDF p. 26), rendered at 110 dpi, agrees word for word with l.493–512. The Remark does not print « connexe »; Prop. 7′ prints « connexe et balayable »; the conclusions read « gE ⊂ P » and « gM ∈ P; gN ∈ P ».

labels.label: bzrem:c2s2r1_cas_affin
labels.notes: Elaborated type (#check @Benzecri.cas_affin, probe compiled against `import Benzecri`): for every n, V : Type u_1 with [ChartedSpace (Fin n → ℝ) V] [HasGroupoid V (affGroupoid n)], G : Subgroup (GXAut (GAR n) (Fin n → ℝ) V), IsBalayableFor (GAR n) … G, IsPocheAff P φ z, every l with Fact (l ≠ 0) and every j : (Fin n → ℝ) ≃ᵃ[ℝ] openHemisphere l. Conclusion: HasGroupoid V (projGroupoid n) ∧ (Injective GXAut.affToProj ∧ ∀ g x, affToProj g • x = g • x) ∧ IsBalayableFor (GSR n) (S n) V (G.map affToProj) ∧ IsPocheProj P l (φ.trans j) (z.comp j.symm) ∧ (PreconnectedSpace V → (∀ E compact, ∃ g ∈ G, g • E ⊆ P) ∧ ∀ M N, ∃ g ∈ G, g • M ∈ P ∧ g • N ∈ P). Each assertion against l.493–505: « Pour la structure localement projective de V (déf. 12, remarque) » is projOfAff, the strict canonical structure (independent of j by remarque_affine_vers_projective), and the first conjunct shows it is locally projective. « G est un groupe d'automorphismes projectifs » is the injective group morphism affToProj, under which each automorphism acts as itself (rfl); G is identified with G.map affToProj. The third conjunct is the step the Remark leaves implicit: V is sweepable for that image with the same compact. « si j désigne un homéomorphisme de ℝⁿ sur un hémisphère H̊ (j compatible avec les structures affines), (P, H̊, j∘φ, z∘j⁻¹) est une poche » is quantified over every l ≠ 0 and every affine bijection ℝⁿ ≃ H̊. That is the reading of the marked strict Remark after Déf. 1′ (IsPocheAff.toPocheProj), and an affine bijection onto H̊ is automatically a homeomorphism (isOpenEmbedding_coe_affineEquiv). « La proposition 7 et son corollaire sont donc vrais aussi dans le cas affin » gives both assertions with g in G itself, which is stronger than g in the image. It is stated under PreconnectedSpace V, the connectedness of Déf. 12 (see readings_ruling). The first four conjuncts need neither connectedness, T2 nor second countability, so they are stronger than printed. No hypothesis is added. Every dimension is covered, n = 0 included (no NeZero). Non-vacuity: an audit probe applied cas_affin both to the half-space (isBalayable_demiEspaceOuvert, exists_isPocheAff_demiEspace, j from Sphere.nonempty_hemi_affineEquiv) and to ℝⁿ with translationSubgroup and isPocheAff_model. Both compile.

labels.label: bzprop:c2s2p7prime_compact_dans_poche_affine
labels.notes: Elaborated types. compact_dans_poche_affine: ∀ {n} {V : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace V] [ChartedSpace (Fin n → ℝ) V] [HasGroupoid V (affGroupoid n)] [PreconnectedSpace V] {G : Subgroup (GXAut (GAR n) (Fin n → ℝ) V)}, IsBalayableFor (GAR n) (Fin n → ℝ) V G → ∀ {P φ z}, IsPocheAff P φ z → ∀ {E}, IsCompact E → ∃ g ∈ G, g • E ⊆ P. deux_points_dans_poche_affine has the same hypotheses and concludes ∀ M N, ∃ g ∈ G, g • M ∈ P ∧ g • N ∈ P. Against l.507–512, hypothesis by hypothesis. « variété localement affine »: the strict encoding, with T2 and second countability dropped (weaker). « connexe »: PreconnectedSpace (weaker). « balayable pour un groupe G d'automorphismes affins »: a Subgroup of GXAut (GAR n) with IsBalayableFor (strict Déf. 15). « poche (P, φ, z) »: IsPocheAff (strict Déf. 1, marked). « E un compact »: IsCompact, which is weaker than Bourbaki's compact. Both conclusions are carried, with « ⊂ » read as ⊆ as AUDIT-1 of T-bz-c2-compact accepted for Prop. 7. Every n, n = 0 included. CompactDansPocheAffinePrinted n (#print) quantifies over V : Type with T2Space, ConnectedSpace and SecondCountableTopology, every G, every pocket and every compact E, with both assertions. That is the printed sentence word for word, and compactDansPocheAffinePrinted n is the anchor instantiated. Non-vacuity. compactDansPocheAffine_hypotheses_model instantiates every printed hypothesis on ℝⁿ for every n: Connected, T2 and second countable, IsBalayableFor of translationSubgroup with K = {0}, and IsPocheAff univ refl 0. A probe applied compact_dans_poche_affine to it with the closed unit ball. compactDansPocheAffine_hypotheses_demiEspace does the same for the half-space with the non-constant cote x₀ (a probe confirmed two points of P with different x₀). exists_smul_subset_slab_demiEspace applies compactDansPocheAffinePrinted (n+1) to it, so every instance argument (ChartedSpace, HasGroupoid, T2, Connected, SecondCountable on the Opens subtype) is synthesised and the theorem fires. Proof term: the direct Benzecri constants of compact_dans_poche_affine are compact_dans_poche, IsPocheAff.toPocheProj, hasGroupoid_projOfAff, Sphere.nonempty_hemi_affineEquiv, isOpenEmbedding_coe_affineEquiv and this file's affToProj transfer. There is no pseudo-length, Prop. 3, 4 or 6 constant outside compact_dans_poche, whose independence from OQ-45 and OQ-61 was checked on its proof term by T-bz-c2-compact AUDIT-1.

findings.where: CasAffin.lean:61 (checklist, first row) and :77–84 (SCOPE, « connexe »); REPORT.json labels[0].questions[0]
findings.what: The connectedness reading is justified by the standing convention and by Prop. 7′'s printed « connexe ». The direct textual ground is missing: Déf. 12 (ch1 l.304–309) defines a « variété localement affine » on a « variété … convexe [sic: connexe] », so the Remark's V is connected by definition. The checklist's first row lists Hausdorff and second countability as dropped but says nothing about connectedness, which is not used for the first four conjuncts and is PreconnectedSpace for the fifth. The mark is unaffected.
findings.fix: At graduation, add to the SCOPE paragraph: « Déf. 12 (ch1 l.304–309, [sic] convexe → connexe) makes a variété localement affine connected; so the Remark's V is connected as printed ». Extend the first checklist row with « connected (Déf. 12): not used for (1)–(4); `PreconnectedSpace V` for (5) ». The REPORT question can then be closed as settled by the text; no OQ is needed.

findings.where: CasAffin.lean:85–89 (SCOPE, « Independent of OQ-45 and OQ-61 »)
findings.what: The text says « Should OQ-61 (a) add a non-constant cote to Déf. 1, the hypothesis only strengthens, the theorems stand ». That covers IsPocheAff in hypothesis position. It omits that (a) adds the field to Déf. 1′ as well, so cas_affin's 4th conjunct (IsPocheProj, a conclusion) strengthens. That conjunct stands only once the strict IsPocheAff.toPocheProj is re-proved with the new field, which is immediate since z∘j⁻¹ is non-constant iff z is. It also omits that the ℝⁿ witness compactDansPocheAffine_hypotheses_model (z ≡ 0) would no longer hold.
findings.fix: Wording: « … the hypothesis only strengthens; the conclusion IsPocheProj of cas_affin follows once IsPocheAff.toPocheProj carries the new field (z∘j⁻¹ is non-constant iff z is); the ℝⁿ witness (z ≡ 0) lapses, and the half-space witness still applies (n ≥ 1) ». Mirror it in REPORT notes.

findings.what: The « finding » is true: the Remark does not say that V is sweepable for G viewed as a group of projective automorphisms. But it is a one-line proof step, not an error or omitted hypothesis in the DEC-27 sense. Sweepability depends only on the action, which is literally unchanged. Sent to the author as a finding, it would overstate what is wrong with the text.
findings.fix: At curation, record it as a proof note (SCOPE or kb), not as a finding against the paper. The row stays closed and marked.
